name: Secret Lab
summary: Tucked away inside a sunken crater in southern Azshara, the Secret Lab is a clandestine goblin testing facility hidden behind rocky bluffs. Dedicated to reckless technological and biological experimentation, the compound is a chaotic testament to what happens when goblin innovation outpaces basic safety protocols.

sections.title: Unchecked Ambition
sections.body: Carved into an isolated crater, the Secret Lab was established by ambitious goblin researchers seeking an out-of-the-way site for high-risk experiments. Free from external oversight, technicians here tinker with everything from rocket propulsion to bio-engineering local raptors. In true goblin fashion, however, the drive for breakthroughs comes at the expense of containment and fire safety, turning what was meant to be a covert research outpost into an accident waiting to happen.

sections.title: Containment Catastrophe
sections.body: Run by Director X. Nizzlebex, the facility recently succumbed to total mayhem. Flammable chemicals and explosive rocketry ignited widespread blazes across the compound, leaving panicked research interns scurrying to extinguish themselves. To make matters worse, experimental raptor test subjects—coded simply by number—have broken loose, seeking bloody retribution against their handlers while chaos engulfs the burning crater.

faq.answer: The Secret Lab is an isolated research facility tucked into a crater in southern Azshara. It was constructed by goblins seeking privacy to conduct dangerous experiments on rocketry and animal genetic modification.

faq.q: Why is the lab burning down?
faq.answer: Goblin engineering relies heavily on combustible fuel, experimental rocketry, and lax safety precautions. An accident within the compound triggered fires that quickly spread out of control, leaving the staff scrambling to contain the damage.

The facility is under the direction of X. Nizzlebex. However, during the recent disaster, communications have completely broken down, and the automated assistance buzzers report that no one is currently answering.

faq.q: What kind of experiments were being conducted here?
faq.answer: Researchers at the lab focused primarily on advanced rocketry and intelligence tests on local fauna, most notably enhancing raptors into numbered subjects such as Subject Four and Subject Nine.

faq.q: Why are the raptors attacking the staff?
faq.answer: The fire and structural collapses damaged containment enclosures, allowing specimens like Subject Four to break loose. Holding a grudge over cruel laboratory testing, the escaped raptors have turned on humanoid staff and visitors alike.

angles.text: The smoking ruins and discarded rocket parts illustrate the ultimate pitfalls of goblin engineering when volatile schematics are deployed without proper containment.
